text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the pretext of endurance training,
I brought K.S. Miracle out on a hiking trip.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We saw a bird earlier that I've never seen before.
Did you notice it? Oh, and a mother squirrel with her baby, too!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah. The fresh air feels wonderful. If building stamina
can be like this, I'd love to do it regularly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Truth be told, that wasn't the sole reason.
The main goal was to give K.S. Miracle a chance to unwind.
choice_data_list: (...Or at least, that was the plan.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We've walked quite a bit. ...Trainer, are you alright?
You're... breathing pretty heavily, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps everyday fatigue is catching up with me, but this is draining
far more stamina than I anticipated. K.S. Miracle peeks at me with worry.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we rest here and head back together?
If it's just this kind of stamina training, I can always do it on my—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We came all this way so she could relax;
it would defeat the entire purpose if I held her back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wishing above all else that this turns into a wonderful day for her,
I forced a smile and kept putting one foot in front of the other.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew. We finally made it.
...Trainer, let's sit on that bench over there and rest.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please... there's no need to apologize.
We walked quite a long way, so it's only natural to be tired.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I sit down on the bench, doing my best to hide my trembling legs.
Leaning my elbows on the table in front of me, I catch my breath.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Would you like some cold water?
I was actually just getting thirsty myself, so I'll go buy us some!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching K.S. Miracle jog off toward the shop,
I breathe a sigh of relief that we made it here in one piece.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I let my body go limp and slump onto the table. The accumulated fatigue
and my depleted stamina hit me all at once, pulling my consciousness straight into a dream—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...You really did walk a lot, didn't you?
Make sure you drink some water when you wake up, okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(You're so exhausted that you won't even wake up when I speak to you.
...I suppose that makes sense. Because, Trainer... you're always...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Always working so hard for my sake... and because of my body,
you have to worry about so much more than normal trainers do.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My gratitude toward you...
is far more than mere words could ever express, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...You brought me out here today just so I could rest, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I noticed.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, K.S. Miracle. You don't have to give up on anything.
...It's going to be okay. We're right here with you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Everyone who worries about me always has such kind, gentle eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Kei-chan! Were you reading a picture book? Oh my, what a lovely swan.
...Thank goodness, you seem to be feeling better today.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Eat as much as you can, and let's do our best with your walking rehab.
Mom and I will be working hard right alongside you. ...We'll always be by your side.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Because... you always speak to me with such warmth in your voice.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I can tell.
Just how deeply you care for me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...It's rather silly of me, isn't it? Pretending not to notice your kindness
just so I can put your mind at ease.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Kind people get hurt easily. Because they try to shoulder
everyone else's pain too. Even though... you really don't have to.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
............
Hehe. I can hear your breathing so clearly from right next to you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please rest just a little longer.
I promise... I'll wake you up before the sun goes down.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The train is pretty empty, isn't it?
Trainer, please don't mind me and stay seated.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Standing like this counts as training for me, after all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haha, how many times is that now?
I was the one who let you sleep, so please don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turns out I had fallen fast asleep after that.
I panicked terribly when I was woken up, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at K.S. Miracle's face, she is smiling happily.
Falling asleep was definitely a blunder on my part, but did today help her unwind?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how painful things get, or how hard she pushes herself,
she never views it as a burden—she embraces it as a joy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To become someone K.S. Miracle can truly lean on,
someone she can let herself depend on, I need to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, I can't just sit here moping.
I need to learn from today's mistake...
choice_data_list: I must have bored you while I was asleep.
I must have bored you while I was asleep, huh?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
I could hear the birds chirping, and I had a very relaxing time.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I could hear you breathing in your sleep, too.
Did you have any nice dreams?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle smiles warmly and serenely.
...I feel somewhat embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what? You can't do that! That's bad for your health...
If you were to collapse, Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Really? Thank goodness.
Haha, you actually had me worried there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle lets out a relieved sigh.
And with that, she turns her gentle, serene gaze back toward me.
